extracted.name: Football Cheese Ball
extracted.description: This football cheese ball made with creamy Cheddar, green onions, and taco seasoning is the perfect crowd-pleasing appetizer for game-day parties.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 slice American cheese, sliced into strips
instruction_lines: Mix together cream cheese, Cheddar cheese, green onions, Worcestershire sauce, and taco seasoning mix in a large bowl until well combined.
Press cheese mixture into a ball and transfer to a sheet of plastic wrap.
Use the plastic wrap to press cheese ball into the shape of a football by flattening ball and rounding each end.
Place cheese football on a plate and arrange American cheese strips on the top like laces. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
Remove cheese ball from the refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.
